systems.sourceScope: Castor C = YY Gem Ca+Cb unresolved source; not an individual Ca/Cb measurement
systems.note: Confirmed YY Gem double-lined eclipsing pair, MSC Ca/Cb under Cab. The tentative Cab-Cc timing companion is not admitted. The uncertain intermediate C branch does not invalidate the independently confirmed 0.814-day Ca/Cb pair. Published individual properties use the exact YY Gem A/B convention.

components.label: Ca
components.name: Castor Ca
components.note: YY Gem A is the star eclipsed at phase zero in Kochukhov & Shulyak 2019; map it to MSC Ca, retaining the former C selection ID.

components.label: Cb
components.name: Castor Cb
components.note: YY Gem B is the other eclipsing component; map it to MSC Cb.

systems.sourceScope: Spica former Aab source; unresolved close-binary contributions and possible tertiary light; not an individual Aa/Ab measurement
systems.note: Explicit mapping of the confirmed 4.014-day SB2 to the primary/secondary of Tkachenko et al. 2016. Keep the already represented Ac record separate. Frost et al. 2025 (updated preprint) independently detects three sources; its photometric mass ratios do not supersede the resolved binary dynamical masses. No uncertain intermediate occultation companion is added.

components.label: Aa
components.name: Spica Aa
components.note: Normalize the confirmed MSC Aa1 (4.014-day spectroscopic primary) to literature Aa, retaining bright-spica and its existing catalog aliases.

components.label: Ab
components.name: Spica Ab
components.note: Normalize the confirmed MSC Aa2 spectroscopic secondary to literature Ab. This is not the uncertain 1.73-year occultation object called Ab in the older intermediate hierarchy.
